title: NODE — 03:40 / 03:52

features.name: a butcherbird, recorded behind a bakery
features.desc-on-touch: Months before, in a town with little else between the road leading in and the one leading out, a microphone on a picnic table and a bird singing a little song.

features.name: the maintenance log, two entries circled in pencil
features.desc-on-touch: He was looking down the column for a mistake in the schedule. She ran her finger across the line instead. This one sends it there, she said, and here, look, this one sends something back.

features.name: the receiving tree, an hour north
features.desc-on-touch: At three forty a filename blinks into being. Nobody has touched anything. At three fifty-two the module sends a file back to the tree that sent the first. Same name. Same size.

features.name: one ear bud each
features.desc-on-touch: The outgoing copy, opened while she still had the other ear bud.

inscription: a conversation between machines for their own pleasure, not for ours

file.name: Butcherbird_BehindBakery.wav
file.note: Sent 03:40. Returned 03:52, same name, same size, running backwards. Not addressed to you.

reverie.title: REVERIE — under the receiving tree, 3.40am
narr: You drove the hour north and neither of you slept.
At three forty a filename blinked into being. It took so long to arrive.
You passed her an ear bud. You both knew the butcherbird at once,
the little song from the picnic table behind the bakery.
At three fifty-two the same file went back, running backwards.
You reached to stop it. She put her hand on yours and kept listening.

exits.label: a maintenance round, a towel spread beneath a tree
